faqs.question: Where exactly is Jasper at Brigade El Dorado located?
faqs.answer: Jasper at Brigade El Dorado, KIADB Aerospace Park, Huvinayakanahalli, Jala Hobli, Bagalur, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 562149. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: 2 BHK Urban, 2 BHK Grand, 3 BHK Urban, 3 BHK Comfort, 3 BHK Grand. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 740–1561 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: A publicly listed 2 BHK resale home of 938 sq ft is advertised at ₹94 lakh. The listing uses the combined Jasper and Iridium name; confirm the exact tower and continuing availability. The developer’s 35/40 lakh microsite figures are historical and are not used as current prices.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Under construction. Published timeline: Secondary registered completion September 2025; confirm unit handover. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Swimming pool, Gymnasium, Clubhouse, Tennis court, Mini cricket field, Mini-golf green. Parent township claim; confirm Jasper access and completion. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: Two and three bedroom homes 740 to 1561 sq ft super built up range 466 to 996 sq ft carpet range. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
